name: Brikpanel: WooCommerce Admin Dashboard Theme
author: Brksoft

sections.description:
Brikpanel is the ultimate WooCommerce admin dashboard plugin for store owners, agencies and developers who need speed, clarity and data-driven insights.

  • Tired of a cluttered WordPress admin?
  • Need a custom WooCommerce dashboard that shows the metrics that matter?
  • Want built-in WooCommerce reporting without expensive SaaS fees?

Brikpanel delivers a clean, mobile-friendly WooCommerce admin panel packed with conversion widgets, sales reports and order-management shortcuts – all inside your WordPress site.

Why Brikpanel?

  • WooCommerce dashboard theme → Instantly modern UI, no code.
  • Advanced WooCommerce reporting plugin → Revenue, AOV, cart reports & more.
  • WooCommerce analytics dashboard → Track live visitors and conversion journey.
  • WooCommerce order management plugin → Lightning-fast search & bulk actions.
  • WooCommerce client dashboard → Perfect hand-off for agencies.

FEATURES

  • 📊 Clean WooCommerce Dashboard – declutters menus & widgets.
  • 🖥️ Responsive Admin Layout – works on desktop, tablet, mobile.
  • 🔍 Blazing-Fast Order Search (⌘/Ctrl + K).
  • ⚡ Modern Sidebar & Icons – focus on store tasks.
  • 🌐 Translation-Ready (.pot included).
  • 🛍️ Conversion Journey – see how users behave before purchase.
  • 👀 Most Viewed Pages – discover high-traffic content.
  • 🛒 Most Added-to-Cart Products – boost top performers.
  • 🔴 Live Visitors Widget – real-time store traffic.
  • 💰 Best-Selling Products Report – instant revenue snapshot.
  • 📈 Custom WooCommerce Reports – export daily sales, product, cart & customer data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/brikpanel or install via Plugins → Add New → Upload.
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to Brikpanel → Settings and enable the modules you need.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the WooCommerce dashboard widgets?

Yes. You can hide widgets on the Dashboard by using the screen options button in the upper right corner.

Will it work compatibly with the Admin Menu Editor plugin?

Yes, it works in full compatibility.

Is Brikpanel a theme or a plugin?

Plugin. It works with any theme and page-builder.

Will it slow down my site?

Not at all. Brikpanel is lightweight and optimized for speed. It enhances your admin panel experience without affecting your front-end store performance. Your WooCommerce shop stays fast, while your dashboard becomes even faster.
